name: Lightfused Sanguithorn
tooltip:
Lightfused Sanguithorn
5 yd range
2.5 sec cast
Once only usable as an edible plant for fleeting magical power, recent evolutionary changes and alchemical breakthroughs with bloodthistle have led to its use across the professions. This more potent growth has come to be known as sanguithorn, and still boasts fearsome magical capabilities.

Sanguithorn are known to tether themselves to rocks, either above or under the ground, so check for them in more rugged terrain.

A strange light has begun to afflict the herbs growing within Quel'Thalas. They grow large and golden, reminiscent of the Sunwell itself, but twisted somehow. Gathering these herbs will release motes of holy energy that sear if caught, but yield additional resources.

Discovery: Midnight Gathering Nodes
